Job Description
A rapidly growing technology organization is seeking a  Data Solutions Engineer  to design, enhance, and maintain a business-critical analytics platform used by strategic business teams. This role is ideal for an experienced Python developer who enjoys building data-driven applications, solving complex data challenges, and delivering insights that drive business decisions. 
The successful candidate will work on a production-grade analytics solution that processes large volumes of information from diverse sources, integrates with internal and external systems, and delivers reporting, visualization, and decision-support capabilities. This position offers a unique opportunity to work directly with business stakeholders while building scalable solutions that impact day-to-day operations. 
This is a fully remote opportunity within the United States.

  Desired Skills & Experience    Experience with Streamlit, Gradio, Dash, Taipy, or similar Python UI frameworks  Experience implementing data validation frameworks such as Pydantic or Pandera  Familiarity with geospatial analytics and data processing  Experience within insurance, financial services, or other regulated industries  Experience deploying and maintaining cloud-based analytics applications  Knowledge of SQL and modern data engineering concepts  Background in sales analytics, data quality initiatives, or data governance programs
  What You Will Be Doing
